bio:
Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable). 'Ann' 4 in 1850.

FamilySearch gives Anna Jane's marriage to Truman Monroe Gregory at Wilkes-Barre on 21 Mar 1872, the 1880 census with her as 'Annie J Gregory', and her dates as 22 Aug 1845 to 25 Oct 1909 ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Anna Jane Scott (L7G2-G2T), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/L7G2-G2T
